import sys
import bisect

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    sorted_list = []
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        x = int(data[i])
        bisect.insort(sorted_list, x)
    print(sorted_list[n // 2])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
